# About this book {.unnumbered}

This learning book accompanies the proposed Distributed Systems syllabus at the Faculty of Informatics, Juraj Dobrila University of Pula.

Lecturer: assoc. prof. Nikola Tankovic, PhD

Chapter 1 develops the foundations of distributed systems through a university submission example, illustrated explanations, and exercises with suggested reasoning. It accompanies a 60-minute lecture in English.

Chapters 2–12 are short sample placeholders for the planned course sequence. They demonstrate the publishing structure and will be expanded lecture by lecture. They are not yet complete teaching materials.
